title: get_health_check_status
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/ returns 200 with a string indicating the health status when the service is healthy.

title: post_auth_register_with_valid_data
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid email and password returns 201 with TokenResponse containing access and refresh tokens.

title: post_auth_login_with_valid_credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid user credentials returns 200 with TokenResponse containing access and refresh tokens.

title: post_auth_refresh_with_valid_token
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with a valid refresh token returns 200 with new access and refresh tokens in TokenResponse.

title: post_auth_logout_with_valid_access_token
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/logout with a valid Authorization Bearer access token returns 200 with no content.

title: get_auth_google_redirect
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/auth/google returns 302 redirect to Google OAuth consent page.

title: get_auth_google_callback_with_provider_code
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/auth/google/callback with a valid provider code returns 200 with TokenResponse containing access and refresh tokens.

title: get_auth_facebook_redirect
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/auth/facebook returns 302 redirect to Facebook OAuth consent page.

title: get_auth_facebook_callback_with_provider_code
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/auth/facebook/callback with a valid provider code returns 200 with TokenResponse containing access and refresh tokens.
